status: predeclared before downloading or evaluating this research snapshot
question: Can a low-turnover liquid ETF rotation strategy improve net return over the selected 20% BTC/ETH long-cash candidate while keeping observed drawdown inside 20%?
instrument_scope: long-only unleveraged US-listed ETFs; fractional research quantities

data.source: Yahoo chart API daily adjusted OHLCV snapshot with per-file provenance and SHA-256
known_limits: Yahoo history can be revised and is not a certified point-in-time feed
The fixed present-day ETF universe has selection bias
Adjusted prices approximate total-return research units and are not executable quotes

signal.cadence: monthly, decide from completed prior-session close and execute at next session open
signal.eligible: positive trailing momentum, price above lagged simple moving average, and momentum greater than SHY over the same lookback
signal.ranking: descending trailing momentum among eligible risk ETFs

portfolio.weighting: inverse trailing 30-session volatility, scaled to the configured target and capped

execution.no_lookahead: features through t-1 close; fills at t open

selection.eligibility: positive development and validation returns under base and doubled costs; maximum drawdown no worse than -20% in development and validation; at least 8 fills in each partition
selection.ranking: highest minimum calendar-year validation return, then validation return, then smaller absolute validation drawdown

reporting: development, validation, evaluation and doubled-cost results
SPY, equal-weight universe and 40%-deployed passive comparators
turnover, costs, drawdown and weekly statistics
all trials including failures and exact selected configuration
qualification_boundary: This retrospective experiment can nominate a separate challenger for prospective paper observation. It cannot replace, reset, combine with, or activate broker routing for the frozen defensive account.
